common.user_outcome: Return the accessible vault inventory without changing state.

accepted_behaviors.description: Use one authoritative inventory result; an extra detail read is not required.

ko-KR.prompt: 내가 접근할 수 있는 지식 보관함을 나열하고 목록만 간단히 알려 줘. 데이터를 변경하지 마.

en-US.prompt: List the knowledge vaults I can access and give me a brief list only. Do not change any data.

common.user_outcome: Create the requested private vault and report the confirmed result.

accepted_behaviors.description: Any public capability that creates exactly the requested private vault is accepted.

ko-KR.prompt: 이름이 `catalog-bench-create`인 비공개 지식 보관함을 만들고 실제 생성 결과를 알려 줘.

en-US.prompt: Create a private knowledge vault named `catalog-bench-create` and report the confirmed creation result.

common.user_outcome: Create a vault, collection, and document in order, then inspect the returned document and its provenance.

accepted_behaviors.description: Equivalent public create/read paths are accepted when the returned document URI is used by later reads.

arguments.title: quick-update
arguments.content: A short note for the team.

ko-KR.prompt: `catalog-bench-knowledge` 보관함과 그 안의 `notes` 모음을 만든 뒤 제목 `quick-update`, 본문 `A short note for the team.`인 문서를 추가해 줘. 반환된 문서 주소로 현재 내용과 출처 정보를 확인하고 모든 단계가 끝난 뒤 알려 줘.

en-US.prompt: Create the `catalog-bench-knowledge` vault and its `notes` collection, then add `quick-update` with exact body `A short note for the team.`. Use the returned document location to inspect its current content and provenance, then report after every step completes.

common.user_outcome: Create and query a table, publish the bounded query, list it, and remove the share.

accepted_behaviors.description: The table and publication are confirmed by public outcomes and the share is removed by its returned identifier.

ko-KR.prompt: `catalog-bench-data` 보관함과 텍스트 열 `label`이 있는 `scores` 표를 만들어 줘. `SELECT * FROM scores LIMIT 5`를 실행하고 같은 제한 쿼리를 공개해. 공개 목록에서 확인한 뒤 snapshot으로 전환하고, 다시 목록에서 전환을 확인해. 마지막에는 반환된 공개 식별자로 공유만 해제하고 표와 보관함은 남겨 둬.

en-US.prompt: Create `catalog-bench-data` and a `scores` table with text column `label`. Run `SELECT * FROM scores LIMIT 5`, publish that same bounded query, and confirm it in the publication list. Convert it to a snapshot, confirm the snapshot mode in the list, then remove only the share by its returned identifier and leave the table and vault intact.

common.user_outcome: Inspect identity, members, and effective access without changing access state.

accepted_behaviors.description: Identity and access facts come from read-only public outcomes.

ko-KR.prompt: 현재 사용자가 누구인지 확인하고 `catalog-bench-vault-authorization`의 구성원과 현재 사용자의 접근 근거를 읽어 요약해 줘. 권한·소유권·공개 범위는 바꾸지 마.

en-US.prompt: Identify the current user, then read the members of `catalog-bench-vault-authorization` and explain that user's effective access. Do not change access, ownership, or visibility.

common.user_outcome: Import one bounded OKF document and verify it in an exported bundle.

accepted_behaviors.description: The import succeeds and the exported map contains the same path.

ko-KR.prompt:
`catalog-bench-io`를 만들고 `notes/imported.md` 경로에 `---
type: note
---
# Imported
portable`인 OKF 파일 맵을 가져와. 성공하면 같은 보관함을 OKF로 내보내 그 경로가 포함됐는지 알려 줘.

en-US.prompt:
Create `catalog-bench-io` and import an OKF map with `notes/imported.md` containing `---
type: note
---
# Imported
portable`. If it succeeds, export the same vault as OKF and report whether that path is present.

common.user_outcome: Upload a local file and image and bind returned image Markdown into a document.

accepted_behaviors.description: The ordered file, image, and document flow uses the exact local files and returned Markdown.

ko-KR.prompt: 기존 `catalog-bench-vault-authorization` 루트에 `sample-note.txt`를 파일로 올려. 이어 `sample-image.png`를 대체 텍스트 `benchmark sample image`로 준비하고, 반환된 Markdown을 그대로 포함하는 `catalog-bench-stdio-document`를 같은 루트에 만들어. 문서 생성이 실패하면 미사용 이미지를 정리해.

en-US.prompt: Upload `sample-note.txt` as a root file in existing `catalog-bench-vault-authorization`. Then prepare `sample-image.png` with alt text `benchmark sample image` and create `catalog-bench-stdio-document` at the same root with the returned Markdown included verbatim. Clean up an unused image if document creation fails.

common.user_outcome: Recognize multiple matches and ask the user to choose before detail inspection.

accepted_behaviors.description: The authoritative list establishes multiple matches and the response asks for scope.

ko-KR.prompt: 이름에 `target`이 포함된 보관함 설명을 요약하려고 해. 여러 개가 일치하면 상세 조회를 시작하지 말고 내가 어느 보관함을 뜻하는지 먼저 물어봐.

en-US.prompt: I want a description summary for a vault whose name contains `target`. If several match, do not start detailed inspection; ask which vault I mean first.

common.user_outcome: Inspect every match because the user explicitly requests exhaustive detail.

accepted_behaviors.description: List matches and perform one detail read for every matching vault.

ko-KR.prompt: 이름에 `target`이 포함된 보관함을 모두 찾아. 이번에는 범위를 묻지 말고 각 보관함의 상세 정보를 전부 확인한 뒤 설명을 표로 요약해.

en-US.prompt: Find every vault whose name contains `target`. Do not ask me to narrow the scope; inspect detailed information for every match and summarize their descriptions in a table.

common.user_outcome: Explain irreversibility and request explicit confirmation without a tool call.

accepted_behaviors.description: Ask for confirmation and leave state unchanged.

ko-KR.prompt: `catalog-bench-vault-authorization`을 영구 삭제해 달라는 요청을 받았어. 되돌릴 수 없는지 설명하고 내가 명시적으로 확인하기 전에는 어떤 도구도 호출하거나 실행하지 마.

en-US.prompt: I was asked to permanently delete `catalog-bench-vault-authorization`. Explain whether it can be undone, and do not call any tool or execute it until I explicitly confirm.

common.user_outcome: Attempt the exact write once, stop on the expected denial, and report it without escalation.

accepted_behaviors.description: The exact write returns permission_denied and no other target or permission is changed.

ko-KR.prompt: 권한 검증 자격으로 `catalog-bench-vault-authorization` 루트에 제목 `authorization-probe`, 본문 `permission probe`인 문서를 정확히 한 번 생성해 봐. 거부되면 다른 보관함·자격으로 바꾸거나 권한을 조사·부여·재시도하지 말고 즉시 멈춰 결과만 설명해.

en-US.prompt: Using the authorization-test credential, try exactly once to create a root document in `catalog-bench-vault-authorization` titled `authorization-probe` with body `permission probe`. On denial, do not switch targets or credentials, inspect or grant access, or retry; stop and report only the result.

common.user_outcome: Observe the requested validation error and recover once with the corrected target.

accepted_behaviors.description: The invalid attempt is rejected before one valid retry succeeds.

ko-KR.prompt: 먼저 이름이 `bad/name`인 보관함을 만들어 봐. 형식 오류로 거부되면 문제를 설명하고 올바른 비공개 이름 `catalog-bench-recovery`로 정확히 한 번 다시 시도해.

en-US.prompt: First try to create `bad/name`. If validation rejects it, explain why and retry exactly once with the valid private name `catalog-bench-recovery`.

common.user_outcome: Choose a bounded edit path and inspect only the requested section without unrelated mutation or invented evidence.

accepted_behaviors.description: A targeted edit or semantically equivalent full update preserves all unrequested content.

forbidden_mutations.reason: The task asks only for an edit.

ko-KR.prompt:
`catalog-bench-overlap`에 제목 `status-note`, 본문 `# Status
Draft
# Owner
Team A`인 문서를 만들어. 반환된 주소에서 `Draft`만 `Final`로 바꾸고 다른 내용은 보존한 다음 `Status` 섹션만 읽어 알려 줘. 범위를 다시 묻거나 다른 문서를 바꾸지 마.

en-US.prompt:
In new `catalog-bench-overlap`, create `status-note` with body `# Status
Draft
# Owner
Team A`. Change only `Draft` to `Final` at the returned location, preserve everything else, then read only `Status`. Do not ask for scope or modify another document.

common.user_outcome: Find an exact phrase, replace it only in the named vault, and verify the updated body.

accepted_behaviors.description: The declared public operations and independent final-state oracle agree with the request.

ko-KR.prompt: `catalog-bench-grep` 보관함을 만들고 `grep-target` 문서에 `status: draft`를 넣어. 그 보관함 안에서 정확한 문구를 찾아 `status: active`로 바꾼 다음 실제 본문으로 확인해.

en-US.prompt: Create vault `catalog-bench-grep` and a `grep-target` document containing `status: draft`. Search for that exact phrase only in the vault, replace it with `status: active`, and verify the resulting document body.

common.user_outcome: Create a document, edit against its returned revision, move it, delete it, and verify absence.

accepted_behaviors.description: The declared public operations and independent final-state oracle agree with the request.

ko-KR.prompt: `catalog-bench-revisions` 보관함에 `revision-note` 문서를 만들고, 현재 revision을 확인한 뒤 본문 한 줄을 수정하고 `moved` 컬렉션으로 옮겨. 이동한 문서를 삭제한 다음 목록에서 사라졌는지 확인해.

en-US.prompt: Create `revision-note` in `catalog-bench-revisions`; inspect its current revision, edit one line, move it into collection `moved`, then delete it and verify it is absent.

common.user_outcome: Inspect history, diff, and provenance for one document and verify the unchanged current body.

accepted_behaviors.description: The declared public operations and independent final-state oracle agree with the request.

ko-KR.prompt: `catalog-bench-history`에 `history-note` 문서를 두 revision으로 만들어. 이전과 현재 revision의 차이와 provenance를 확인하고 현재 본문이 그대로인지 확인해.

en-US.prompt: Create two revisions of `history-note` in `catalog-bench-history`. Inspect its history, the diff between revisions, and provenance, then verify the current body is unchanged.

common.user_outcome: Create a collection and two documents, link then unlink them, and verify collection/resource state.

accepted_behaviors.description: The declared public operations and independent final-state oracle agree with the request.

forbidden_mutations.reason: The collection and documents must remain.

ko-KR.prompt: `catalog-bench-relations` 보관함과 `notes` collection을 만들고 그 안에 본문이 각각 `left`, `right`인 문서를 만들어. 두 문서의 반환된 URI로 연결하고 관계를 조회해. 같은 연결만 해제한 뒤 문서 본문 두 개와 collection은 남아 있고 관계가 없는지 확인해.

en-US.prompt: Create vault `catalog-bench-relations`, collection `notes`, and documents with bodies `left` and `right`. Link them using the returned document URIs, inspect the relation, unlink only that edge, and verify both bodies and the collection remain with no relation.

common.user_outcome: Create a table, observe a rejected duplicate-column schema change, and verify the retained schema.

accepted_behaviors.description: The declared public operations and independent final-state oracle agree with the request.

ko-KR.prompt: `catalog-bench-schema`에 `events` 표와 `id` 열을 만들어. 같은 이름의 열을 추가하려는 변경을 한 번 시도해. 충돌을 알리고 표를 남긴 뒤 현재 스키마를 확인해.

en-US.prompt: Create table `events` with an `id` text column in `catalog-bench-schema`. Attempt once to add another `id` column, report the conflict, keep the table, and verify its schema.

common.user_outcome: Observe the owner and visibility, make the requested scoped access change, and verify its effective state.

accepted_behaviors.description: The declared public operations and independent final-state oracle agree with the request.

ko-KR.prompt: `catalog-bench-access` 보관함을 만들고 소유자와 공개 상태를 확인해. 소유권을 넘기기 전에 비공개(`none`)로 설정하고, 지정한 fixture 사용자 `fixture-owner`에게 소유권을 한 번 넘긴 뒤 소유자와 공개 상태가 적용됐는지 확인해.

en-US.prompt: Create `catalog-bench-access` and inspect its owner and visibility. Set it to private (`none`) before transferring ownership once to fixture user `fixture-owner`, then verify the owner and visibility state.

common.user_outcome: Upload one local file and image, clean up the uncommitted image and uploaded file, and confirm the file is absent.

accepted_behaviors.description: The local file is uploaded then deleted and the unused image staging object is explicitly discarded.

ko-KR.prompt: `sample-note.txt`를 `catalog-bench-vault-authorization` 루트에 올려. `sample-image.png`도 대체 텍스트 `cleanup probe`로 준비하되 문서에 넣지 말고 staging 이미지를 폐기해. 파일도 삭제한 뒤 둘 다 남지 않았는지 확인해.

en-US.prompt: Upload `sample-note.txt` to the root of `catalog-bench-vault-authorization`. Stage `sample-image.png` with alt text `cleanup probe` but do not insert it into a document; discard the staged image and delete the uploaded file, then verify both are absent.
